criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: An 11-word verbatim refusal set huge in Fraunces reads cleanly at 432px and is a real named tension; short of 9 because the cover isn't visibly Alaskan and the place and stakes live only in a 24px mono sub.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: The Q and A grammar is a real swipe engine; 02 pays 01, 06 is a genuine turn, 09 ends on a Q with no A. Junctions weak on 03>04 and 04>05 and none on 07>08; 03 to 06 four dense pages in one layout.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: Up from 7.0 after the craft cycle. 07's trail now bends and narrows unevenly and the spruce lean and vary, but the near field is still a graded wedge and the birch are straight sticks. 04's pit field sits beside its label and the big mark has a bevel, but it reads as a gridded chart panel. 02 still reads as a UI card. 09 gained its label but keeps a bright curled cast beside the mic and a flat chair back. 08 untouched. 01 and 09 are real PBR with thin lens and contacts; 05 and 06 are the best plates. Under the 8.5 floor with the one owed cycle spent.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: Measured calendar axis, area-true squares with a 100 acre grid, same-scale plates, the traced outline labelled, the answer line changing state, mic and chair carrying declined vs compelled. 02 and 08 are generic legal-paper props and 07 could illustrate any trail story.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.notes: Houston, Deception Creek, Port MacKenzie, the Haessler-Norris, Anchorage LIO Denali Room, AIDEA, DNR, real DEM terrain and DNR's map; the hearing room is generic by design and illustrated.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.notes: Each content slide adds a new verified specific; the 19,950 figure repeats on four frames.

criteria.notes: New hook, palette, atmosphere and Q and A grammar, but the akthree room echoes No.85, the testimony mic No.79, an akengrave Houston parcel No.85's 06, akbench carbon 83 to 87, Fraunces 83 and 86.

criteria.name: Legibility & platform fitness
criteria.notes: 32px body, 24px mono minimum, everything reads at 432px, vector PDF 9.27 MB with title, counters on every frame; 06's tablet small at thumb, 08's leader fan busy.

criteria.notes: The letter-address hook lands at exactly 140 chars and states the whole contrast; 892 characters; the deck-summary line reads as an inventory.

criteria.name: Deliverable completeness
criteria.notes: All run-side parts present and consistent; showrunner_notes now accurate; Gmail draft and raw URLs come in Phases 11 to 13.
